reason: Test-only repair of 47 migration and storage tests that were red on origin/main because their code was not updated with deliberate product changes. (1) Since c1d88d9 (0031_runtime_coordination, #960) every runtime revision 0031-0048 refuses to downgrade ('use compatible code rollback'). test_async_rollback, test_migrations and test_session_projection_migration now seed a database at 0030_runtime_switch_lookup (the last revision before that boundary), roll back only across reversible revisions there with the same assertions, re-upgrade to head, and assert that the same downgrade from head is refused and changes nothing. PostgreSQL exercises each run in a fresh schema because a downgrade can no longer reset a shared database; the prune step passes an explicit PoolSettings budget, which PostgreSQL requires since #939. (2) test_database_migration: the async source fixture requests anyio_backend, initializes the database before reflecting it through run_sync, and points each foreign key at the row it references (project_ownership.runtime_id -> runtime_instances, runtime_work_batch_projects.batch_id -> runtime_commands, added in #960). (3) test_database_migration_cli serve: since 2d9f099 (#960) serve launches an independent runtime; the test now checks that serve hands --data-dir to serve_runtime and that the project worker (execution_worker.project_application) gives the application <data dir>/mission-checkpoints.db for SQLite and PostgreSQL, the file SQLite's default_checkpoint_path chooses. (4) test_event_history_retention: abd34d7 (#989) removed the browser_attack kinds from OPERATION_EVENT_OWNER_KINDS while the historical 0018 trigger list keeps them; the test compares against the current map plus those documented extras and still requires real record kinds. The deferred-purge test gates the purge task with asyncio events instead of blocking the loop with threading.Event. (5) test_startup_unreadable_rows awaits recovery directly (client.portal is gone from the async client) and awaits the async seed/recovered callbacks, so the recovery checks run. Selected: every touched test that passes on the branch (SQLite and PostgreSQL).
exclusions: tests/v3/test_database_migration_cli.py::test_postgresql_cli_copy_preserves_chat_and_event_replay_after_lan_restart is not selected: when NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_CLI_URL is set (CI database-migrations job) it fails identically on clean origin/main and on this branch, because its disposable LAN Core builds NebulaStore(url) for PostgreSQL without a connection budget and startup raises 'NEBULA_V3_DB_ADMIN_RESERVE is required for PostgreSQL connection budgeting' (required since 831d0d0, #939). It was not among the repaired tests and is left unchanged. No frontend, native or Playwright cases: only Python tests changed; no product, UI or API code changed.
